scope: Independent one-expression PDF metadata test compile repair review
reviewFindings: Apple declares PDFDocument.documentAttributes as optional [AnyHashable: Any]; the unqualified member has no PDFDocumentAttribute context.

PDFDocumentAttribute.titleAttribute is the documented typed title constant. PDFDocumentAttribute conforms to RawRepresentable and exposes init(rawValue: String). Its explicit raw String avoids relying on AnyHashable equality with the wrapper.
The unchanged exporter assigns the same exact generic title under kCGPDFContextTitle; no project title or internal UUID is substituted.
Optional dictionary access and String cast remain in XCTAssertEqual without a fallback: absent metadata, unmatched key, wrong type or a different title cannot satisfy the expected title.
This source-level API review does not establish the actual PDFKit metadata lookup or rendered output. Fresh Apple compilation and native execution remain necessary.
